title: ASEAN Members' Efforts at Recent Meeting to Address Challenges in Repatriating Refugees from Rakhine State
what_it_is: ASEAN Members' Efforts at Recent Meeting to Address Challenges in Repatriating Refugees from Rakhine State

sections.label: ASEAN needs assessment team
sections.summary: The Terms of Reference for the ASEAN needs assessment team were finalised, though the situation is still evolving.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Members will appreciate that this is a current and still-evolving situation, not all of which is positive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We welcomed the finalisation of the Terms of Reference for the needs assessment team that will be despatched by the ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management.

sections.label: Postponed ASEAN needs assessment
sections.summary: Renewed violence has postponed the despatch of the ASEAN needs assessment team.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Because of this renewed violence, the despatch of the ASEAN needs assessment team has had to be postponed.

sections.label: ASEAN support and limits
sections.summary: No deadline can be imposed for the process; ASEAN can support health, education and inter-faith dialogue but not decide citizenship or political rights.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The point I want to emphasise here is that it is not possible for us, or for ASEAN, to impose a deadline for this process to begin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: When that happens – and we hope that will happen in the not-too-distant future – it is possible for ASEAN to provide support in the form of providing or assisting in the provision of health and education facilities and promoting inter-faith dialogue.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: But on the more difficult and fundamental issues of, for instance, citizenship and political rights, this is not something for ASEAN to decide, or indeed, to debate.

sections.label: ASEAN support in Rakhine
sections.summary: ASEAN stands ready to support all stakeholders in addressing the root causes of the problem in Rakhine state.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: ASEAN stands ready to support the efforts by all stakeholders to address the root causes of the problem in the Rakhine state.

sections.label: Refugees staying while safe
sections.summary: Because refugees are safe and supported there, they will not leave unless certain of better prospects across the border.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The next point is that, paradoxically, because the refugees, in fact, are safe there and are receiving support there, they are not going to leave unless they are certain that they will have better prospects across the border.

sections.label: Children's education and prospects
sections.summary: The speaker shares concern that children could spend their whole childhood deprived of full education and later job prospects.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I know you are focused on education and expressing support in a very real and meaningful way that makes a difference on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I share your concern because, whilst I have said that there are no quick fixes and that it takes time, it would be a tragedy for children to spend their entire childhood in such circumstances, be deprived of a full and proper education and, more importantly, prospects for a job and livelihood later on.

sections.label: Foreigners involvement rejected
sections.summary: The speaker reiterates that foreigners should not get involved and answers no to the Member's point.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: This is not something foreigners should get involved in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: So, I reiterate, therefore, my short answer to that point, which the Member has made repeatedly, is no.

sections.label: ASEAN needs assessment team
sections.summary: The Terms of Reference were settled and ASEAN agreed to be present when conditions suit, to help refugees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: As I said previously, at our recent meeting, we were able to settle the Terms of Reference of the needs assessment team and we agreed that when conditions are suitable, the ASEAN team should be present on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We agreed that the presence of an ASEAN team would help enhance confidence and trust on the part of the refugees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: And ASEAN is also willing in our own, albeit limited, way to participate in providing education, creating jobs and implementing healthcare facilities, in order to help the refugees who need help.
